description: NOAA Climate Prediction Center Oceanic Nino Index (ONI): 3-month running anomaly of sea surface temperature in the Nino 3.4 region, by season, plus a label (El Nino at +0.5 or higher, La Nina at -0.5 or lower, otherwise neutral). Official NOAA CPC threshold; the file is updated monthly. Related tools on this server, for a different need: weather_drought_monitor_us_crop when you need US Drought Monitor county statistics for one US county. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
